a_before_b.rationale: Understanding adapter-based finetuning requires knowing where adapter modules are inserted within transformer layers and how they interact with self-attention and feed-forward components, which is precisely what the Transformer Block Architecture objective covers.

b_before_a.rationale: Mastering adapter-based finetuning is not required to identify the key components of a transformer block or explain how self-attention and feed-forward layers process information in parallel.
